discussed on 4/24 legal call: accepted, meets guidelines

License text on website is not necessarily indicative of what is used on actual files, so @swinslow pulled the text format used in products, so we will use that as guidance for what specifically to add in terms of start/end of license text.

Text to use (without the `**` and `======` markers), taken from sample of their software distribution; "NOTICE TO USER" near the top should be made optional, and copyright text tagged with `<copyrightText>` at the top:

This new license/exception request has been accepted and the information for the license/exception has been merged to the repository. Thank you to everyone who has participated!
The license/exception will be published at https://spdx.org/licenses/ as part of the next SPDX License List release, which is expected to be in three months' time or sooner. In the interim, the new license will appear on the license list preview site at https://spdx.github.io/license-list-data/.
